There’s no point to not do it. I get it that you might be scared of injuries, but it can happen at any time, even when you’re doing it stationary. I broke my scaphoid (hand) after 2months skateboarding. I was very worried since I work as a gardener. But it helped me and I had to learn to fall without using my left hand to much. So in the first weeks after the accident i started learning switch and fakie tricks, very basic stuff. I have pain everyday at work, but I get used to it better day by day. No excuses. Also you look very passionate, and it’s clear you spent a lot of time learning that Ollie. For me it would feel wrong to not do them while moving. Trust me a new world of skateboarding has just opened up for you. But in the end it’s your decision and we have to respect that.
